desc_en: A bold silhouette that redefines contemporary tailoring. This blazer presents an expressive music-inspired design set against a dark backdrop. Crafted with attention to detail and an impeccable drape. A versatile statement piece for distinguished occasions. Available made to order with worldwide shipping.

Confeccionado con atención al detalle y una caída impecable. Una prenda versátil para ocasiones distinguidas. Disponible bajo demanda con envío a todo el mundo.
